Remark
[flatness iff discrete holonomy]

Source: petersen:page-0406 ↗ def:pet-ch10-holonomy-group 1. ch10:10.5.11Show that a manifold is flat if and only if the (restricted) holonomy Lie algebra $\mathfrak {hol}_p=\{ 0\} $, i.e. the holonomy group is discrete.
